title: Matthew, John and 2 Maccabees
summary: Two Gospels join the collection: Matthew and John, each translated afresh from the Greek with notes on its first readers, the manuscripts and where churches read it differently. 2 Maccabees, the story of the Maccabean martyrs and the first Hanukkah, arrives with a full guide to which churches hold it as Scripture. Notes across the library that quote Matthew and John now use the new translation.
